R065-01.notes: Narrator picks the second (full linkage) option, then calls back for cleaning only. B, C and D contradict the text: the narrator never learns repair, gives nothing away, and finds the same lift in the letters, so they came from the same machine.

R065-02.notes: 'it will never stick again.' A reverses the price (three times as much). B and D are not in the passage.

R065-03.notes: The simile matches the bar hanging 'a beat too long' and the need to wait. A is the intended trap, since window-shopping sounds leisurely, but the context is the problem of a sticking key. D overstates.

R065-04.notes: 'Respectful' toward the inherited machine and, by extension, Vesna. This inference is reasonable and is confirmed by the irony of the ending. A, B and C have no support: Pellerin's view is not stated, cleaning is not said to cause damage, and the mother only wanted to give it away.

R065-05.notes: 'For comparison' leads to 'I laid Mr. Pellerin's line beside hers.' B: no evidence of doubt about payment. C is contradicted. D is contradicted, since he typed slowly.

R065-06.notes: 'Did not sound surprised' and his immediate 'Cleaning only, then' show he anticipated the change, consistent with the comparison sheet. A and D have no support. B is contradicted, since cleaning helps and it 'will still stick a little.'

R065-07.notes: He types slowly so that each sticking e bar can return to its resting position before the next key. 'Settle back into place' fits. A and C are literal traps. D: harder striking is not implied. A taker could read 'come home' as 'land fully on the paper,' but no choice states that, so B is the only defensible answer.

R065-08.notes: The lift in the e's is Vesna's trace in the machine, and replacing the linkage would 'erase her.' B is a trap: the existing carbon copies would remain readable. A and C have no support.

R065-09.notes: 'carbon copies, one for every letter she had sent.' C contradicts 'sent.' A and D are wrong.

R065-10.notes: 'I had asked for it before I knew why ... not sure I could explain myself.' A misuses the mother detail, since she wanted to give it away. B and D have no support.
